fullContentHtml:
Short Information : has released the Re-Exam Admit Card for the University Grant Commission UGC National Eligibility Test NET Assistant Professor / JRF June 2026 examination. The online application process for NTA UGC NET June Online Form 2026 were accepted from 29 April 2026 to 24 May 2026. The re-Examination is going to conducted from 09-10 September 2026 Candidates can download their NTA UGC NET June Re-Exam City Details 2026, which are given below.

National Testing Agency (NTA)

NTA UGC NET June Re-Exam Admit Card 2026

NTA UGC National Eligibility Test NET / JRF June 2026

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 29 April 2026
  • Last Date : 24 May 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 24 May 2026
  • Correction Date : 26-28 May 2026
  • Exam Date : 22-30 June 2026
  • Re-Exam Date : 09-10 September 2026
  • Exam City Details : 10 June 2026
  • Admit Card : 17 June 2026
  • Answer Key : 16 August 2026
  • Final Answer Key : 28 August 2026
  • Result : 28 August 2026
  • Re-Exam City Details : 01 September 2026
  • Re-Exam Admit Card : 04 September 2026

Application Fee

  • General : Rs. 1150/- 
  • EWS, OBC : Rs. 600/- 
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 325/- 
  • Pay the Examination Fee Through Debit Card, Credit Card, Net Banking, E Challan, E Wallet, Cash Card Fee Mode Only.

[adinserter block=”3″]

NTA UGC NET June Admissions 2026 : Age Limit

  • JRF : Maximum Age : 31 Years
  • NET : No Age Limit
  • Use Tool –

NTA UGC NET June Admissions 2026 : Course Details

  • Course Name : NTA UGC National Eligibility Test NET / JRF June 2026
  • Exam Conduct : National Testing Agency (NTA)

NTA UGC NET June Admissions 2026 : Educational Qualification

  • Candidates having Post Graduation Degree/appearing in Final year with minimum 55% marks in aggregate from any recognized college / university will be eligible for this test.
  • 4 Year Bachelor Degree Candidate Also Eligible.

How To Download NTA UGC NET June Admit Card 2026

  • In order to download their NTA UGC NET June Admit Card candidates are required to go to the important link section provided below.
  • After getting the link candidates need to click it for downloading their NTA UGC NET June Admit Card.
  • Candidates need to provide their following details-:
  • Registration No. /Roll No.
  • DOB/Password
  • Captcha Code(if specified)
  • After providing their details appropriately candidates will be able to check their NTA UGC NET June Admit Card.
  • Candidates can also check their NTA UGC NET June Admit Card from official site of the NTA.

NTA UGC NET June Application Form 2026 : Mode of Selection

  • Selection will be based on Entrance Test.

Important Question

Q. Has the NTA UGC NET June Result 2026 been released?
Answer. Yes, the NTA UGC NET June Result 2026 has Released by NTA.

Q. When will the NTA UGC NET June Result 2026 be officially announced?
Answer. The NTA UGC NET June Result 2026 is has released on 28 August 2026 by the National Testing Agency (NTA).

Q. When was the NTA UGC NET June examination held?
Answer. The NTA ICAR AIEEA PG, PhD examination was conducted on 22-30 June 2026.

Q. Where can I check the NTA UGC NET June Result 2026?
Answer. Candidates will be able to check the NTA UGC NET June Result 2026 on the official NTA ICAR website: ugcnet.nta.nic.in

Q. What details are required to check the NTA UGC NET June Result 2026?
Answer. Candidates will need their Application Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth / Password to check and download their result.

Q. What is NTA UGC NET Official Website?
Answer. The Official Website of NTA UGC NET is https://ugcnet.nta.nic.in/
